meta.scalability_note: 2 German data centers (Gütersloh, Frankfurt); limited auto-scaling on own infrastructure; no serverless; hybrid focus
meta.performance_note: ISO 27001, ISAE 3402 type II certified; 99.95% SLA; German data centers; enterprise-grade SAN storage
